Pre-fitted count outcome validation example

Source: R/data.R
catecvCountExample.Rd

A reproducible result of applying catecv() to countExample using the Poisson score and five validation iterations. This saved result can be used to illustrate plots and area between curves without refitting the model. The regeneration script is in data-raw/catecvCountExample.R in the package source repository.

Usage

data(catecvCountExample)

Format

An object of class precmed returned by catecv().

Examples

data(catecvCountExample)
abc(catecvCountExample)
#>               cv1       cv2       cv3        cv4       cv5
#> poisson 0.1375899 0.1172791 0.1120313 0.06136285 0.1877103
